verdict.rationale: Mesh documents a per-customer endpoint to set monitoring configuration, with a permission explicitly named "Monitor and unmonitor customers". A companion endpoint returns each customer's monitor status. Together these let a compliance officer turn ongoing screening on and off for specific customers, and alerts from ongoing monitoring flow into case management. Missing for 10: evidence of an enable/disable control in the web application rather than only the API, bulk monitor/unmonitor for a selected set of customers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
